the best performing meta-level classifier is Plurality Voting and that a simple threshold based approach performs better than the more complex base-level classifiers.
• The performance of base-level classifiers is highly dependent on the type of classifier and the feature representation, and is relatively insensitive to the choice of meta-level classifier.

(i) a plurality vote meta-classifier is consistently the best performer, (ii) the performance of the base-level classifiers is highly sensitive to the choice of the features used to represent the accelerometer data, (iii) a simple feature selection method is able to improve the performance of the classifiers, (iv) a combination of the simple features with the more complex features is able to further improve the performance of classifiers.

the problem of recognizing human activity in real time from accelerometer data.
the development of a framework for the recognition of human activities from data collected by wearable sensors.
